description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a compassionate leader to ensure the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. We are looking to fill this vital role quickly.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, staff development, and regulatory compliance. You will play a key role in fostering a positive and collaborative work culture, ensuring that residents receive outstanding care. Join a team committed to making a significant difference in the lives of those they serve.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a DON or ADON
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
